['OMV Deutschland GmbH '].company_description: OMV Deutschland GmbH, a subsidiary of OMV AG, operates in the oil and gas industry, with a focus on sustainability initiatives, digital transformation, and energy efficiency. The company is involved in the production and blending of biofuels that meet EU requirements. Additionally, OMV, through its subsidiary Borealis, is a leading provider of advanced and circular polyolefin solutions, base chemicals, fertilizers, and plastics recycling.

['Deutsche Gesellschaft f\u00fcr Interna.company_description: The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH, often simply shortened to GIZ, is the main German development agency. It provides services in the field of international development cooperation and international education work, with a goal to deliver effective solutions that offer people better prospects and sustainably improve their living conditions. GIZ's main commissioning party is Germany's Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), and it works with partners in national governments, the private sector, civil society, and research institutions. GIZ was established on 1 January 2011, through the merger of three German international development organizations: the Deutscher Entwicklungsdienst (DED), the Deutsche Gesellschaft für Technische Zusammenarbeit (GTZ), and Internationale Weiterbildung und Entwicklung (InWEnt). It is one of the world's largest development agencies, with a business volume in excess of €3.1 billion in 2019 and 22,199 employees spread over more than 120 countries.
